We propose a new representation for image motion that is learned in an unsup-ervised fashion, and that is capable of identifying the characteristic motion pat-terns of many different sequence classes.

a network trained with our method can learn a representation that is useful for motion-related downstream tasks without the need for explicit motion labels.
